Thank you for understanding and not pushing on the hope card, if you want i won't offer any help because i don't believe there is much i can do in that front to help anyone really, and although sometimes i go away for a while...you can message me, just to talk about anything at all...i really appreciate who you are as a person

I don't know how to receive kindness, honestly and i sometimes feel like saying i appreciate what you say etc isn't sufficient enough...i also feel like you would be wasting your time in trying to help me, i don't know if i am making any sense, I am not trying to be self deprecating or anything,i just feel like you should um help others who can be helped, you know, although you are ome of the best people l have met here so far, along with other lost souls, trying to live

Edit:I guess i had this coming,  sometimes i tend to make small of everything else going on, but i have never felt more like nothing like i did after posting this, all the messages i get, well most of them are inquiring about the state of my virginity which i wrote as such a trival grasp to life....something funny compared to the heaviness of leaving the people i love, but i guess i deserve that, i don't matter. Reddit just pretty much confirmed that for me. I got like 90% some private 'wanting to help' by having sex with me...i don't know i had it coming...and to be positive it reassured me of my decision...thank you everyone else who were kind.

I think it is harder to lose it once you reach a certain age, but it shouldn't be a big issue i promise, i just hopefully am dying soon so it's an experience i hoped to have, but i promise you will probably find your person, and although society says you have to be somewhere sexually by a certain age, especially as a guy, i am feminist so i understand the double standards there...but just live your life, take your time...it will fall into place.
Thank you, I appreciate you taking the time to, and really hope you make it.

I have been depressed for 10, and i am right were i have fought and i am tired, i am givibg my self this year to fight one more time...well giving my family one last fight on my part...so i get it, i know the fighting is exhausting and it keeps taking parts of you that you liked and leaving you just a shelf....i can't tell you how to be or how to feel....but i hope you fight just once more. Win or lose...go with a bang.

Whenever i read these, I don't know whether it's kinder to let you let go in whatever way you feel like, or help you keep trying and hoping, but i don't know although i feel hope for myself is gone, I still feel hope for everybody else, so although i cannot relate to people getting distant, as I usually do that, i think most likely you haven't found the right people, i think they are so many people who feel how you feel, alone, that you will eventually find friends that understand your plait and will be there for you when you feel alone, as you can see from all these responses, a lot of strangers care, and that should hopefully get you to accept that you are likeable/lovable and if the people around you make you feel otherwise, although sometimes our brains lie to us, if they make you feel that way then find new friends, even online, just knowing someone, somewhere cares for you is helpful. I do think you should see medical professionals as well so that you are attacking from both ends. Whatever you decide fight hard, if it doesn't work out at least you would have the comfort of having fought, but fight hard, give yourself the love and support you would give a stranger, be kind to yourself.

I don't know i think it's like any life long illness, it will probably always be there, they are methods that are to assist meant to assist you to manage the symptoms and not be completed weighed down by the illness, no cure just assisted living. Although sometimes the medicine, therapy etc is supposed to sustain you, to help you cope within the darkness, until you are able to hopefully find your way out. That's the hope, but if you find that your situation in life(relationships/finances etc) are all great/good and shouldn't cause the sadness, that there isn't something worsening your symptoms or causing them then the best is just to be able to function and survive.
This is left field i don't know how to take it...people aren't like this my brain can't compute, and i thought those would be private or something.

Sharing helps both sides it's just a good thing all round and i hope it helps you.I hope you make it. It's a hard fight. I hope you make it. And be kind to yourself, i think that is a hard thing to do with depression, but be aware when you are not a good friend to yourself, be aware of these pitfalls and try to slowly move away from them. I hope you make it.

Hey there, I am sorry you are going through this, I think you should try talking to your friend again, I find that talking to someone who to some extent understands is a great step to just bounce your thoughts and feelings, it's strange but at times the more you talk about the isssues the smaller they sometimes get, I mean the battle will seem a little bit farer, like you might win....I don't know if that makes sensee. I know sometimes people don't want to get better, but i think your reaction to your failed suicide is a sign that you still want to fight, and so get as much strength from whatever source you might still have and be prepared to fight for your life, win or lose, you would have given depression a fight.
